name: Gastroenterology & endoscopy (category guide)
summary: IBS / reflux / scopes — GP vs private gastro triage, foreigner fee honesty, and how package endoscopy quotes hide sedation and histology add-ons.
body: Chronic bloating, reflux, and ‘just get a scope’ forum advice send expats straight to private gastro clinics. Start with whether a GP work-up (H. pylori, bloods, lifestyle) is enough before endoscopy; functional IBS pathways differ from alarm-feature work-ups. Public hospital gastro as a private patient lets you pick a consultant with shorter waits than subsidised queues — foreigners pay full fees either public-private or fully private. Package gastroscopy/colonoscopy quotes often exclude sedation upgrades, polyp histology, and follow-up consults — get the line items. Corporate hospitalisation riders may cover day-surgery scopes with pre-auth while outpatient consults sit in a separate bucket. Distinct from TCM digestive listings. This is a category guide, not a ranked gastro clinic list.
